data.title: Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025 – Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the year 2025, setting the income tax at €4,311.00 and showing a refund (Guthaben) of €715.00 to be transferred to the account on file.
data.explanation: This letter is the final calculation of your 2025 income tax. Because more wage tax (Lohnsteuer) was withheld than you owe, the Finanzamt will refund €715.00 to the bank account it has on record, without any action needed from you. If you disagree with the calculation — for example about the home-office costs — you have the right to object (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final after that date. Since money is coming to you, you may just want to check the account details and the figures are correct; otherwise no further action is required.
